theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_c1t_rescaled_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (z : Euclid n) (m : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact B → B ∈ 𝓝 z → ContinuousOn g B → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z → ContinuousOn h B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - z‖ ≤ ‖g a - g z‖) → (∀ v : Euclid n, m * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g z v‖) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ b in {b : Euclid n | z + s • b ∈ B}, h (z + s • b) * f (s⁻¹ • (g (z + s • b) - g z))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (h z * ∫ b, f (fderiv ℝ g z b)))
